This lofty valuation stands in stark contrast to the company's deteriorating fundamentals, highlighted by a compounded profit growth of -147% over the trailing twelve months and actively decelerating earnings growth [E13, E50]. Furthermore, profitability is severely depressed, generating a return on equity of a mere 0.32% and a return on assets of 0.33%, both of which drastically underperform their respective sector benchmarks of 10.09% and 4.88% [E7, E8]. Speculative behavior is evident as recent price growth exceeds profit growth by 129%, demonstrating that market expectations are wildly running ahead of actual financial delivery [E42]. Long-term wealth destruction compounds these operational weaknesses, evidenced by a negative 3% compounded share price growth over five years and an 18% decline over the past year [E14, E16].
